# Pull Requests are not currently accepted

Thank you for taking the time to prepare a contribution.

myTbot currently operates a closed-contribution model. Outside Pull Requests are not accepted and will be closed unmerged. This keeps copyright ownership clean and preserves the commercial licensing path for organisations that require terms outside AGPL v3.

Please open a GitHub Issue instead, describing the bug, feature idea or proposed approach so the internal Emfasys Ltd team can review it and, where appropriate, implement the change internally.
